description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeSubordinateAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CRUD operations, validation rules, and service interactions related to employee subordinates and reporting methods in the HR management system.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateAPITest
classes.description: This class contains unit tests for the EmployeeSubordinateAPI to ensure correct behavior of subordinate management features, including fetching, creating, updating, deleting, and validation logic for subordinate relationships.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportingMethodService
methods.description: Tests that the EmployeeSubordinateAPI correctly returns an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodService.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodConfigurationService
methods.description: Tests that the EmployeeSubordinateAPI correctly returns an instance of ReportingMethodConfigurationService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Verifies fetching a subordinate relationship and reporting method details for a specific subordinate, including response normalization and metadata.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Checks validation rules for fetching a single subordinate, including user access control considerations.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Checks validation rules for fetching all subordinates for an employee.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of subordinates for an employee, verifying correct data and metadata.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new subordinate relationship, including service interaction and response normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for creating a subordinate relationship.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies updating a subordinate relationship and associated reporting method, ensuring correct service calls and response.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for updating subordinate relationships.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of subordinate relationships and verifies the service method is called appropriately, expecting an exception if record not found.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for deleting subordinates.
